name: descriptor-contract-path
title: Move the published setup descriptor off the consumer discovery path
description: R1: this repository publishes its setup descriptor at config/routed-review-setup-v1.json, byte-for-byte the path the vendored probe reads for an INSTALLED descriptor, so the router self-matches as its own consumer and its own pull requests fail review. Move it to contract/ and update every reader. Split out of 08-08-installer-durable-lane.
creator: sdelmas
